purpose: Define the fixed-CI/correlated basis-assembly contract for the first operator lane before any accepted correlated kernel exists.
required_inputs: locked basis size or convergence policy

required_checks.requirement: The target module exposes the basis-assembly contract entrypoint.
The reported basis family aligns with the fixed-CI implementation declaration.
The reported convergence policy aligns with the fixed-CI implementation declaration.
The contract lists the required fixed-CI inputs explicitly rather than leaving them implicit.
The contract still states that runnable basis assembly is missing, so no accepted correlated kernel claim is allowed.

claim_boundary: This manifest defines the fixed-CI basis-assembly contract only. It does not assemble a correlated basis or implement a correction operator.
